title: AIPC: Evidence-Guided Agent Workflows for PyTorch Project Deployment
title_zh: AIPC：面向PyTorch项目部署的证据引导智能体工作流

paragraphs.en: Deploying and optimizing a PyTorch inference project on a dedicated accelerator, especially an on-device NPU, usually cannot be done through the framework’s device API alone as with CUDA; the project must also be converted into hardware-runtime artifacts and adapted to the target toolchain and application interface. Platforms differ in model formats, quantization flows, operator support, and toolchain interfaces, so model adaptation, numerical correctness, and hardware performance problems often have to be located, repaired, and rechecked back and forth across the model (PyTorch/ONNX), toolchain, runtime, and device-execution layers. LLM Agents can invoke tools to handle such cross-layer faults, but without project constraints they may still drift off task because of insufficient domain knowledge, an overly large space of configuration and repair choices, or poor path selection.
paragraphs.zh: 在专用加速器（尤其是端侧 NPU）上部署和优化 PyTorch 推理项目，通常无法像 CUDA 那样仅通过框架的设备 API 完成，还必须将项目转换为硬件运行时产物，并适配目标工具链与应用接口。 各平台在模型格式、量化流程、算子支持和工具链接口上各不相同，因此模型适配、数值正确性和硬件性能问题往往需要在模型（PyTorch/ONNX）、工具链、运行时和设备执行各层之间反复定位、修复和复核。 大语言模型智能体可以调用工具来处理此类跨层故障，但在缺乏项目约束的情况下，由于领域知识不足、配置与修复 choices 的空间过大或路径选择不佳，它们仍可能偏离任务。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion), an Agent method for deploying PyTorch inference projects. AIPC combines structured Skills with toolchain, runtime, and profiling evidence to drive cross-layer diagnosis and repair, and organizes model adaptation, runtime artifact building, on-target execution, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into one deployment flow. We evaluate AIPC on the on-device NPU path of Qualcomm QAIRT, covering vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion models. In two optimization cases, AIPC’s optimization knowledge and strategies guide the Agent to accuracy and performance gains: under the predefined accuracy and latency criteria, 6/7 Skill arm Whisper-Small runs meet all criteria versus 0/6 in the control arm; YOLO-Worldv2 reaches an end-to-end speedup of 2.791 × \times (control arm 1.599 × \times ). Under a pre-fixed deployment contract, AIPC Skill, tool permissions, and check conditions, some runs achieved zero in-run human intervention (0-HITL). We also run an auxiliary experiment to examine the ability of Qwen3.8-27B, a model capable of local deployment, to drive an Agent workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出 AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion），一种用于部署 PyTorch 推理项目的智能体方法。 AIPC 将结构化 Skills 与工具链、运行时以及性能剖析证据相结合，以驱动跨层诊断与修复，并将模型适配、运行时产物构建、目标设备执行、精度修复和性能优化组织为一个统一的部署流程。 我们在高通 QAIRT 的端侧 NPU 路径上评估 AIPC，覆盖视觉、语音、大语言模型和扩散模型。 在两个优化案例中，AIPC 的优化知识与策略引导智能体取得精度和性能提升：在预定义的精度与时延标准下，Skill 实验组 7 个 Whisper-Small 运行中有 6 个满足全部标准，而对照组 6 个运行中为 0 个；YOLO-Worldv2 达到 2.791 × \times 的端到端加速（对照组为 1.599 × \times）。 在预先固定的部署契约、AIPC Skill、工具权限和检查条件下，部分运行实现了零人工干预（0-HITL）。 我们还进行了一项辅助实验，以考察能够本地部署的模型 Qwen3.8-27B 驱动智能体工作流的能力。

paragraphs.en: On-device and edge AI inference provides AI PCs, smartphones, intelligent vehicles, industrial robots, and edge IoT devices with AI compute that offers low latency and high energy efficiency and supports offline operation and data locality. For device backends such as CUDA [ 1 ] that are integrated into PyTorch [ 2 ] , developers can execute models directly through framework interfaces; dedicated accelerators, especially on-device NPUs, usually require converting the model into hardware-runtime artifacts. However, model deployment spans frameworks, graph representations, conversion tools, runtimes, and device backends, whose interfaces, operator coverage, layouts, and inspection methods are not consistent. Deployment knowledge and failure information are therefore scattered among the model, compilation, runtime, and on-device execution layers, and as the numbers of models and target configurations grow, the expert cost of maintaining the deployment flow grows as well. This paper takes Qualcomm QAIRT as its primary implementation and evaluation target and examines the following coupled engineering problems:
paragraphs.zh: 端侧与边缘 AI 推理为 AI PC、智能手机、智能汽车、工业机器人和边缘物联网设备提供 AI 算力，具备低时延和高能效，并支持离线运行与数据本地化。 对于已集成到 PyTorch [2] 中的 CUDA [1] 等设备后端，开发者可以通过框架接口直接执行模型；而专用加速器，尤其是端侧 NPU，通常需要将模型转换为硬件运行时制品。 然而，模型部署横跨框架、图表示、转换工具、运行时和设备后端，而它们的接口、算子覆盖、数据布局和检查方法并不一致。 因此，部署知识与失败信息散布在模型、编译、运行时和端侧执行各层之中，并且随着模型数量和目标配置的增长，维护部署流程的专家成本也随之增长。 本文以 Qualcomm QAIRT 作为主要的实现与评估对象，并考察以下相互耦合的工程问题：

sents.en: This paper takes Qualcomm QAIRT as its primary implementation and evaluation target and examines the following coupled engineering problems:
sents.zh: 本文以 Qualcomm QAIRT 作为主要的实现与评估对象，并考察以下相互耦合的工程问题：

paragraphs.en: Challenge 1: Deployability — “Can it run?”
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 1：可部署性——“它能运行吗？”

paragraphs.en: On-device deployment requires converting the dynamic-graph semantics of PyTorch into artifacts accepted by the target runtime. Dynamic shapes, control flow, complex indexing, and non-standard operators may all cause conversion, compilation, or loading failures.
paragraphs.zh: 端侧部署需要将 PyTorch 的动态图语义转换为目标运行时所接受的产物。 动态形状、控制流、复杂索引以及非标准算子都可能导致转换、编译或加载失败。

sents.en: On-device deployment requires converting the dynamic-graph semantics of PyTorch into artifacts accepted by the target runtime.
sents.zh: 端侧部署需要将 PyTorch 的动态图语义转换为目标运行时所接受的产物。

sents.en: Dynamic shapes, control flow, complex indexing, and non-standard operators may all cause conversion, compilation, or loading failures.
sents.zh: 动态形状、控制流、复杂索引以及非标准算子都可能导致转换、编译或加载失败。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 2: Accuracy Correctness — “Does it still compute the same function?”
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 2：准确性正确性——“它仍然计算相同的函数吗？”

paragraphs.en: Successful conversion and build do not guarantee that the original model semantics are preserved. Problems such as all-zero outputs, NaN/Inf, tensor-order mismatches, and numerical drift after quantization must be detected through automated alignment checks against reference outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 转换和构建成功并不能保证原始模型的语义得到保留。 诸如全零输出、NaN/Inf、张量阶数不匹配以及量化后的数值漂移等问题，必须通过与参考输出进行自动化对齐检查来检测。

sents.en: Successful conversion and build do not guarantee that the original model semantics are preserved.
sents.zh: 转换和构建成功并不能保证原始模型的语义得到保留。

sents.en: Problems such as all-zero outputs, NaN/Inf, tensor-order mismatches, and numerical drift after quantization must be detected through automated alignment checks against reference outputs.
sents.zh: 诸如全零输出、NaN/Inf、张量阶数不匹配以及量化后的数值漂移等问题，必须通过与参考输出进行自动化对齐检查来检测。

paragraphs.en: Challenge 3: Performance Optimization — “Does it really use the accelerator efficiently?”
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 3：性能优化——“它真的高效利用了加速器吗？”

paragraphs.en: Running successfully does not mean running efficiently. Unsupported operators, layout conversion, and limited graph fusion cause CPU fallback, cross-device data movement, or extra memory access. Exploiting the target accelerator’s performance also requires hardware-aware optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 运行成功并不意味着高效运行。 不支持的算子、布局转换以及有限的图融合会导致 CPU 回退、跨设备数据搬运或额外的内存访问。 要充分发挥目标加速器的性能，还需要进行硬件感知优化。

sents.en: Running successfully does not mean running efficiently.
sents.zh: 运行成功并不意味着高效运行。

sents.en: Unsupported operators, layout conversion, and limited graph fusion cause CPU fallback, cross-device data movement, or extra memory access.
sents.zh: 不支持的算子、布局转换以及有限的图融合会导致 CPU 回退、跨设备数据搬运或额外的内存访问。

sents.en: Exploiting the target accelerator’s performance also requires hardware-aware optimization.
sents.zh: 要充分发挥目标加速器的性能，还需要进行硬件感知优化。

paragraphs.en: These challenges force developers to iterate repeatedly among the model, conversion configuration, runtime build, and on-device checks, limiting deployment efficiency and scalability. AgentDeploy [ 3 ] reports that experts spent around 6 h on image-recognition tuning alone, while semi-experts and non-experts required about 60 h and 80 h, respectively, for speech-sentiment-analysis optimization and adaptation. Agents can assist diagnosis and repair in this repeated cross-layer work, while project checks constrain execution.
paragraphs.zh: 这些挑战迫使开发者在模型、转换配置、运行时构建和设备端检查之间反复迭代，限制了部署效率和可扩展性。 AgentDeploy [ 3 ] 报告称，专家仅在图像识别调优上就花费了约 6 小时，而半专家和非专家在语音情感分析的优化与适配中分别需要约 60 小时和 80 小时。 智能体可以协助这项重复的跨层工作中的诊断与修复，同时项目检查约束执行。

sents.en: These challenges force developers to iterate repeatedly among the model, conversion configuration, runtime build, and on-device checks, limiting deployment efficiency and scalability.
sents.zh: 这些挑战迫使开发者在模型、转换配置、运行时构建和设备端检查之间反复迭代，限制了部署效率和可扩展性。

sents.en: AgentDeploy [ 3 ] reports that experts spent around 6 h on image-recognition tuning alone, while semi-experts and non-experts required about 60 h and 80 h, respectively, for speech-sentiment-analysis optimization and adaptation.
sents.zh: AgentDeploy [ 3 ] 报告称，专家仅在图像识别调优上就花费了约 6 小时，而半专家和非专家在语音情感分析的优化与适配中分别需要约 60 小时和 80 小时。

sents.en: Agents can assist diagnosis and repair in this repeated cross-layer work, while project checks constrain execution.
sents.zh: 智能体可以协助这项重复的跨层工作中的诊断与修复，同时项目检查约束执行。

paragraphs.en: In response to these challenges, existing tools provide model conversion, compilation optimization, and code repair, but three key gaps remain among them:
paragraphs.zh: 针对这些挑战，现有工具提供了模型转换、编译优化和代码修复，但它们之间仍存在三个关键差距：

paragraphs.en: (1) Toolchain feedback does not form a repair loop (missing loop from tool feedback to repair) : Converters, compilers, and runtimes can usually report on-device errors, numerical deviations, or backend information, but this information does not turn itself into repair actions. Developers still have to decide whether to modify the PyTorch model, the ONNX graph, or the runtime configuration, and then rebuild and re-verify. What is missing is the closed loop of “toolchain feedback → \rightarrow cross-layer diagnosis → \rightarrow repair → \rightarrow rebuild → \rightarrow re-verification.”
paragraphs.zh: (1) 工具链反馈未形成修复闭环（缺少从工具反馈到修复的闭环）：转换器、编译器和运行时通常能够报告设备端错误、数值偏差或后端信息，但这些信息不会自行转化为修复动作。 开发者仍需自行决定是修改 PyTorch 模型、ONNX 计算图，还是运行时配置，然后重新构建并重新验证。 所缺失的正是“工具链反馈 \rightarrow 跨层诊断 \rightarrow 修复 \rightarrow 重新构建 \rightarrow 重新验证”的闭环。

sents.en: (1) Toolchain feedback does not form a repair loop (missing loop from tool feedback to repair) : Converters, compilers, and runtimes can usually report on-device errors, numerical deviations, or backend information, but this information does not turn itself into repair actions.
sents.zh: (1) 工具链反馈未形成修复闭环（缺少从工具反馈到修复的闭环）：转换器、编译器和运行时通常能够报告设备端错误、数值偏差或后端信息，但这些信息不会自行转化为修复动作。

sents.en: Developers still have to decide whether to modify the PyTorch model, the ONNX graph, or the runtime configuration, and then rebuild and re-verify.
sents.zh: 开发者仍需自行决定是修改 PyTorch 模型、ONNX 计算图，还是运行时配置，然后重新构建并重新验证。

sents.en: What is missing is the closed loop of “toolchain feedback → \rightarrow cross-layer diagnosis → \rightarrow repair → \rightarrow rebuild → \rightarrow re-verification.”
sents.zh: 所缺失的正是“工具链反馈 \rightarrow 跨层诊断 \rightarrow 修复 \rightarrow 重新构建 \rightarrow 重新验证”的闭环。

paragraphs.en: (2) Missing automated result verification : Successful conversion and compilation do not guarantee correct output. Without automatically running inference, aligning with reference outputs, and checking the target backend, silent failures such as NaN/Inf, all-zero outputs, and CPU fallback are hard to detect systematically.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 缺少自动化结果验证：成功的转换与编译并不能保证输出正确。 若不自动运行推理、与参考输出对齐并检查目标后端，NaN/Inf、全零输出、CPU 回退等静默失败就难以被系统性地发现。

sents.en: (2) Missing automated result verification : Successful conversion and compilation do not guarantee correct output.
sents.zh: (2) 缺少自动化结果验证：成功的转换与编译并不能保证输出正确。

sents.en: Without automatically running inference, aligning with reference outputs, and checking the target backend, silent failures such as NaN/Inf, all-zero outputs, and CPU fallback are hard to detect systematically.
sents.zh: 若不自动运行推理、与参考输出对齐并检查目标后端，NaN/Inf、全零输出、CPU 回退等静默失败就难以被系统性地发现。

paragraphs.en: (3) Missing deterministic execution boundary for open-ended diagnosis : An LLM Agent (e.g., ReAct [ 4 ] ) can handle errors that were not enumerated in advance, but may also retry blindly or drift off task.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 缺乏面向开放式诊断的确定性执行边界：LLM 智能体（例如 ReAct [ 4 ] ）能够处理事先未枚举的错误，但也可能盲目重试或偏离任务。

paragraphs.en: Building on earlier AIPC reports [ 5 , 6 ] , this paper extends AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion) , a runtime-feedback-driven Agent method for on-device model porting. AIPC organizes platform knowledge, execution scripts, stage checks, and deployment requirements into reusable Skills, and chooses the repair layer and subsequent path based on model, device, and runtime feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期 AIPC 报告 [ 5 , 6 ] 的基础上，本文对 AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion）进行了扩展，这是一种由运行时反馈驱动、用于端侧模型移植的智能体方法。 AIPC 将平台知识、执行脚本、阶段检查和部署要求组织为可复用的技能（Skills），并基于模型、设备和运行时反馈来选择修复层及后续路径。

sents.en: Building on earlier AIPC reports [ 5 , 6 ] , this paper extends AIPC (AI Porting & Conversion) , a runtime-feedback-driven Agent method for on-device model porting.
sents.zh: 在早期 AIPC 报告 [ 5 , 6 ] 的基础上，本文对 AIPC（AI Porting & Conversion）进行了扩展，这是一种由运行时反馈驱动、用于端侧模型移植的智能体方法。

sents.en: AIPC organizes platform knowledge, execution scripts, stage checks, and deployment requirements into reusable Skills, and chooses the repair layer and subsequent path based on model, device, and runtime feedback.
sents.zh: AIPC 将平台知识、执行脚本、阶段检查和部署要求组织为可复用的技能（Skills），并基于模型、设备和运行时反馈来选择修复层及后续路径。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-guided deployment workflow for existing inference projects : Taking a PyTorch project as the entry point, it brings the model, pre/post-processing, I/O contract, and target-device requirements into a single deployment process, and outputs runtime artifacts, project configuration, and run records.
paragraphs.zh: 面向现有推理项目的反馈引导部署工作流：以 PyTorch 项目为入口，将模型、前/后处理、I/O 契约和目标设备要求纳入统一的部署流程，并输出运行时产物、项目配置和运行记录。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-guided cross-layer diagnosis, repair, and recheck : Toolchain, runtime, numerical, and profiling feedback helps the Agent decide at which layer to repair — the model graph, the project interface, or the runtime configuration — and then rebuild and recheck the affected paths. For example, when AOT (ahead-of-time) compilation runs out of on-chip scratchpad memory, the Agent can localize the cause to the ONNX decoder graph. Deployment results are confirmed by project checks and run records.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈引导的跨层诊断、修复与复检：工具链、运行时、数值和性能剖析反馈帮助智能体决定应在哪一层进行修复——模型图、项目接口还是运行时配置——然后重建并复检受影响的路径。 例如，当 AOT（提前）编译耗尽片上暂存内存时，智能体可以将原因定位到 ONNX 解码器图。 部署结果通过项目检查和运行记录来确认。

paragraphs.en: QAIRT proof-of-concept and reusable engineering lessons : AIPC is implemented on the QAIRT on-target NPU, and representative cases report runtime-artifact build, on-target execution, output alignment, profiling, and failure recovery.
paragraphs.zh: QAIRT 概念验证与可复用的工程经验：AIPC 在 QAIRT 的片上 NPU 上实现，代表性案例报告了运行时产物的构建、片上执行、输出对齐、性能分析以及故障恢复。

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Can an Agent workflow complete target-device deployment of PyTorch projects? How does the AIPC Skill affect deployment paths and delivery outcomes?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1：智能体工作流能否完成 PyTorch 项目的目标设备部署？ AIPC Skill 如何影响部署路径与交付结果？

sents.zh: RQ1：智能体工作流能否完成 PyTorch 项目的目标设备部署？

sents.zh: AIPC Skill 如何影响部署路径与交付结果？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: In representative execution-failure cases, how do runtime, toolchain, and output-comparison results trigger the Agent’s cross-layer diagnosis, repair, and recheck?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：在具有代表性的执行失败案例中，运行时、工具链和输出比对结果如何触发智能体的跨层诊断、修复与复查？

paragraphs.en: For accelerators integrated as PyTorch device backends, developers usually run models through interfaces such as .to(device) or .cuda() . Dedicated hardware runtimes usually do not execute models through these device APIs; instead, the project is exported as a computation graph, a runtime artifact is built, and inference runs through a hardware-specific runtime interface. This path helps exploit hardware performance, but it also introduces adaptation problems.
paragraphs.zh: 对于作为 PyTorch 设备后端集成的加速器，开发者通常通过 .to(device) 或 .cuda() 等接口来运行模型。 专用硬件运行时通常不通过这些设备 API 来执行模型；而是将项目导出为计算图，构建运行时产物，并通过硬件特定的运行时接口进行推理。 这一路径有助于发挥硬件性能，但也带来了适配问题。

paragraphs.en: Frameworks such as ONNX [ 7 ] , ONNX Runtime [ 8 ] , ExecuTorch [ 9 ] , LiteRT [ 10 ] , and MNN [ 11 ] provide conversion and inference infrastructure; TVM [ 12 ] , MLIR [ 13 ] , IREE [ 14 ] , and Microsoft Olive [ 15 ] provide graph, kernel, or configuration optimization. They typically do not turn device-specific conversion, runtime, numerical, or profiling feedback into corresponding repairs and rechecks.

paragraphs.en: Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) [ 17 ] is Qualcomm’s official inference software stack for heterogeneous SoCs that integrate a CPU, Adreno GPU, and Hexagon NPU, covering vision models through generative models; HTP (Hexagon Tensor Processor) is the tensor-compute accelerator of the Hexagon NPU, and QAIRT can dispatch supported models to this backend.
paragraphs.zh: Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) [ 17 ] 是 Qualcomm 官方面向异构 SoC 的推理软件栈，这些 SoC 集成了 CPU、Adreno GPU 和 Hexagon NPU，覆盖从视觉模型到生成式模型；HTP（Hexagon Tensor Processor）是 Hexagon NPU 的张量计算加速器，QAIRT 可以将受支持的模型调度到该后端。

paragraphs.en: Three main model artifacts. (1) DLC (Deep Learning Container, .dlc ) : a serialized graph container; (2) QNN model library ( .so / .dll ) : generated by target compilation of the C++ model source and static weights output by the converter, and therefore dependent on the compiler, ABI, operating system, and target architecture; (3) Context Binary : an execution context generated from a DLC or QNN model library by ahead-of-time (AOT) precompilation for a target backend/SoC and saved as a .bin .
paragraphs.zh: 三种主要的模型产物。 (1) DLC（Deep Learning Container，深度学习容器，.dlc）：一种序列化的图容器；(2) QNN 模型库（.so / .dll）：由转换器输出的 C++ 模型源码和静态权重经目标编译生成，因此依赖于编译器、ABI、操作系统和目标架构；(3) Context Binary（上下文二进制）：针对目标后端/SoC 通过提前（AOT）预编译从 DLC 或 QNN 模型库生成的执行上下文，并保存为 .bin。

paragraphs.en: QAI AppBuilder, Model Builder, and AIPC. QAI AppBuilder [ 24 ] is an on-device AI application platform built on QAIRT and open-sourced by Qualcomm (BSD-3-Clause). It provides Python and C++ APIs on the target side, which can load QAIRT model artifacts, configure the target backend, and run inference, so that tensors, graphs, buffers, and layouts need not be managed directly through the lower-level C++ QAIRT SDK API. Model Builder is its built-in package for model conversion and deployment. AIPC is a Skill-based workflow method inside Model Builder for deployment work.

paragraphs.en: A typical deployment chain includes: (1) PyTorch-to-ONNX export; (2) conversion and runtime-artifact build; (3) optional quantization and Context Binary preparation; (4) application-interface integration and on-target inference; and (5) profiling-driven iterative optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 典型的部署链路包括：(1) PyTorch 到 ONNX 的导出；(2) 转换与运行时构建产物的生成；(3) 可选的量化与 Context Binary 的准备；(4) 应用接口集成与目标设备上的推理；以及 (5) 基于性能剖析的迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: Hardware and toolchain characteristics. [ 17 ] (1) The VTCM (Vector Tightly Coupled Memory) of HTP provides low-latency on-chip storage for compute tiles; when a single tile exceeds the available capacity, graph compilation may fail or off-chip data access may increase. (2) The QNN converter may change ONNX I/O to a Spatial-First layout (e.g., NHWC), thereby changing the I/O contract; the QAIRT converter usually preserves the source layout. Unsupported operators, dynamic shapes, or complex control flow may cause failures at the conversion, compilation, or execution stage.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件与工具链特性。 [ 17 ] (1) HTP 的 VTCM（向量紧耦合内存）为计算瓦片提供低延迟的片上存储；当单个瓦片超出可用容量时，图编译可能失败，或片外数据访问可能增加。 (2) QNN 转换器可能将 ONNX 的输入/输出更改为 Spatial-First 布局（例如 NHWC），从而改变输入/输出契约；QAIRT 转换器通常保留源布局。 不支持的算子、动态形状或复杂的控制流可能导致转换、编译或执行阶段出现失败。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the direct QAIRT SDK path, HTP is also available through the QNN integrations of ONNX Runtime, LiteRT, ExecuTorch, MNN, and llama.cpp [ 25 ] , fragmenting deployment paths for the same hardware.

paragraphs.en: In recent years, LLM Agents have been used for NPU deployment, runtime integration, and edge inference. Prior work [ 5 ] explored an Agent-driven, toolchain-centered QAIRT deployment workflow, and [ 6 ] applied the workflow to vision models on OpenVINO, RKNN, TensorRT, and ONNX Runtime QNN EP. This paper further extends PyTorch project adaptation and adds accuracy-repair and performance-optimization capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大语言模型智能体已被用于 NPU 部署、运行时集成和边缘推理。 已有工作 [ 5 ] 探索了一种由智能体驱动、以工具链为中心的 QAIRT 部署工作流，[ 6 ] 则将该工作流应用于 OpenVINO、RKNN、TensorRT 和 ONNX Runtime QNN EP 上的视觉模型。 本文进一步扩展了 PyTorch 项目适配，并增加了精度修复和性能优化能力。

paragraphs.en: Chip vendors have also begun to encode hardware and software-stack knowledge as Agents or Skills to support operator development, performance diagnosis, model migration, and inference optimization. AMD’s ROCm AI provides reusable Agent Skills [ 26 ] , and Hyperloom [ 27 ] optimizes inference workloads on AMD GPUs; Huawei’s Ascend/agent-skills [ 28 ] and CANNBot-Skills cover model conversion, inference deployment, profiling, and Ascend C operator development; and Intel Xe-Forge [ 29 ] targets kernel optimization on Intel XPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 芯片厂商也开始将软硬件栈知识编码为智能体或技能，以支持算子开发、性能诊断、模型迁移和推理优化。 AMD 的 ROCm AI 提供可复用的智能体技能 [ 26 ]，Hyperloom [ 27 ] 则优化 AMD GPU 上的推理工作负载；华为的 Ascend/agent-skills [ 28 ] 和 CANNBot-Skills 覆盖模型转换、推理部署、性能剖析和 Ascend C 算子开发；Intel Xe-Forge [ 29 ] 则面向 Intel XPU 上的内核优化。

sents.zh: 芯片厂商也开始将软硬件栈知识编码为智能体或技能，以支持算子开发、性能诊断、模型迁移和推理优化。

sents.en: AMD’s ROCm AI provides reusable Agent Skills [ 26 ] , and Hyperloom [ 27 ] optimizes inference workloads on AMD GPUs; Huawei’s Ascend/agent-skills [ 28 ] and CANNBot-Skills cover model conversion, inference deployment, profiling, and Ascend C operator development; and Intel Xe-Forge [ 29 ] targets kernel optimization on Intel XPUs.

paragraphs.en: Spatial-NPU Agent Skill [ 30 ] is based on MLIR-AIR and uses a staged Agent Skill to support the deployment and optimization of decoder-only LLMs on the AMD XDNA 2 NPU; AgentDeploy [ 3 ] mainly searches tunable optimization parameters such as the pruning rate and partitions models across multiple inference engines according to operator support; and EdgeFM [ 31 ] targets edge VLM/LLM kernel optimization. Related work also starts from kernel, operator, or configuration search and optimizes using compilation, correctness, or profiling feedback [ 9 , 29 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] . AIPC, in contrast, takes an existing PyTorch inference project as its unit of work and organizes cross-model-type adaptation, runtime model and code generation, on-target inference, accuracy repair, and performance optimization into a complete workflow.

paragraphs.en: AIPC comprises two execution components: the Model Builder and the Optimizer . The Model Builder builds a PyTorch inference project into a deployment baseline on the target device; the Optimizer takes this baseline as input and generates optimized variants that satisfy accuracy and target-backend constraints. The Agent calls these components and, guided by the AIPC Skill, reads state, selects tools, and proposes repair candidates.

paragraphs.en: AIPC organizes a deployment workflow around Config , Pass , and Gate . Config fixes the project entry, I/O contract, target device, runtime paths, and resource constraints; a Pass is a configurable stage unit that defines inputs, outputs, checks, Gates, and candidate actions; a Gate is a status value derived from artifacts and run results that triggers a Pass to continue, repair, transfer to another Pass, or stop. Passes form the workflow; in project setup, the engineer can skip or add steps as the project requires, and the Agent selects tools and candidate repairs within this flow.

paragraphs.en: The Model Builder takes a PyTorch project, deployment Config, and Gate conditions as inputs; its outputs are the target runtime artifacts, the project interface adaptation, and the deployment baseline. The target runtime defines its corresponding default Passes; a project may skip or add steps as needed (for example, the FP16 path skips quantization), but must preserve their required inputs and Gates.

paragraphs.en: The default Passes of the QAIRT path are: P0 project and environment configuration, P1 PyTorch/NPU adaptation, P2 ONNX export and reference preparation, P3 graph check and operator repair, P4 conversion, quantization, and runtime build, P5 Context Binary preparation, P6 application interface and on-target inference, P7 accuracy report, and P8 profiling. paragraphs.en: P1: PyTorch/NPU adaptation. Before export or SDK-converter invocation, P1 handles representation differences between the source project and the target NPU, for example fixing dynamic shapes or control flow, externalizing the autoregressive cache, establishing an exportable model entry, and, when needed, rewriting RoPE or Multi-Head Attention into static tensor computation better suited to execution on the target NPU.
paragraphs.zh: P1：PyTorch/NPU 适配。 在导出或调用 SDK 转换器之前，P1 负责处理源项目与目标 NPU 之间的表示差异，例如修复动态形状或控制流、将自回归缓存外置化、建立可导出的模型入口，并在需要时将 RoPE 或多头注意力改写为更适合在目标 NPU 上执行的静态张量计算。

paragraphs.en: P3: Graph check and operator surgery. P3 turns unsupported structures or operators reported by an exporter or converter into graph-repair tasks. The Agent can choose an equivalent rewrite whose preconditions are satisfied at the PyTorch, export-entry, or ONNX-graph layer; the concrete repair layer is determined by project configuration and current feedback. Each rewrite preserves the input/output conditions, and reference-output comparison, subsequent conversion, and target execution checks decide whether it proceeds to the next Pass.
paragraphs.zh: P3：图检查与算子手术。 P3 将导出器或转换器报告的不受支持的结构或算子转化为图修复任务。 智能体可以选择一个等价重写，其前置条件在 PyTorch 层、导出入口层或 ONNX 图层得到满足；具体修复层由项目配置和当前反馈决定。 每次重写都会保持输入/输出条件，参考输出对比、后续转换以及目标执行检查决定其是否能进入下一个 Pass。

paragraphs.en: When a Gate fails, the Model Builder routes the problem to the PyTorch, ONNX, or runtime-interface layer based on logs, output comparison, and runtime feedback, and re-runs from the affected Pass. Graph rewriting, operator replacement, graph partitioning, and I/O/layout repair all belong to the Builder’s deployment repair. Each run retains the Config, Pass artifacts, command logs, and comparison results, so that later Passes can reuse existing state rather than having the Agent re-guess project conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 当某个 Gate 失败时，模型构建器（Model Builder）会根据日志、输出对比和运行时反馈，将问题路由到 PyTorch、ONNX 或运行时接口层，并从受影响的 Pass 开始重新运行。 图重写、算子替换、图切分以及 I/O/布局修复都属于构建器（Builder）的部署修复范畴。 每次运行都会保留配置（Config）、Pass 产物、命令日志和对比结果，以便后续 Pass 能够复用已有状态，而无需智能体重新猜测项目条件。

paragraphs.en: The Optimizer is an internal, non-open-source extension that the company’s internal customer-support engineering team has used to provide model-optimization support to external customers. It takes a deployment artifact as its baseline and uses profiling, VTCM, operator behavior, numerical or task feedback, and the graph-optimization knowledge substrate to select quantization adjustments, ONNX equivalent graph surgery, or runtime-configuration candidates. The knowledge substrate encodes graph-rewrite patterns and their applicability preconditions, hardware-benefit hypotheses, historical positive and negative cases, and candidate-selection rules. A candidate becomes the new optimization baseline after rebuilding and passing the acceptance Gate; candidates that do not satisfy accuracy, project I/O, or target-NPU execution requirements are rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 优化器是一个内部非开源扩展，公司内部的客户支持工程团队一直使用它为外部客户提供模型优化支持。 它以部署工件作为基线，利用性能剖析、VTCM、算子行为、数值或任务反馈以及图优化知识底座，来选择量化调整、ONNX 等效图手术或运行时配置候选方案。 知识底座编码了图重写模式及其适用前提条件、硬件收益假设、历史上的正例与负例，以及候选方案选择规则。 候选方案在重新构建并通过验收门禁后将成为新的优化基线；不满足精度、项目 I/O 或目标 NPU 执行要求的候选方案会被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy optimization uses the FP reference, target-device outputs, and numerical error or task metrics to locate overall deviation, sensitive outputs, and task-accuracy degradation, and requires A/B comparisons that change one variable at a time, with the activation and weight calibration methods treated as two independent variables. For problems that are hard to localize, the Optimizer can further analyze clipping effects, layer-wise output deviations, and residual outliers. Candidates include calibration data and methods, per-tensor/per-channel/per-row quantization granularity, global low precision or mixed precision, FP16 retention of sensitive layers or output heads, and equivalent graph rewrites for numerical repair.
paragraphs.zh: 精度优化利用FP参考输出、目标设备输出以及数值误差或任务指标来定位整体偏差、敏感输出和任务精度下降，并需要进行每次只改变一个变量的A/B对比，其中激活值校准方法和权重校准方法被视为两个独立的变量。 对于难以定位的问题，Optimizer可以进一步分析截断效应、逐层输出偏差以及残差异常值。 候选方案包括校准数据与校准方法、逐张量/逐通道/逐行的量化粒度、全局低精度或混合精度、对敏感层或输出头保留FP16，以及用于数值修复的等价图改写。

paragraphs.en: The workflow starts from a runnable PyTorch inference project, reference inputs, an inference script, and model weights, and delivers a hardware-runtime script, target model artifacts, and a work report with check, accuracy, and performance records; task results can be confirmed by human review or an independent evaluation program.
paragraphs.zh: 该工作流从一个可运行的 PyTorch 推理项目、参考输入、推理脚本和模型权重开始，最终交付硬件运行时脚本、目标模型产物，以及包含检查、精度和性能记录的工作报告；任务结果可通过人工审核或独立的评估程序进行确认。

paragraphs.en: Users start tasks in natural language. For project-level deployment, the user first states the target device, precision, or optimization requirements, for example “Set up a deployment project using QNN FP16”; the Agent initializes the working directory and Config accordingly and generates candidates for the remaining derivable configuration. For parameters that cannot be derived, such as LLM context length, the Agent may first propose a candidate value, or stop on a blocking condition and request user input. After confirmation, the Agent can run continuously (continuous mode), or pause after each stage and continue only upon user confirmation (interactive mode); the user can also state the deployment goal and constraints in a single prompt. Single tasks (for example, generating a Context Binary for an audited quantized DLC) can invoke the corresponding script directly. The resulting model package can be handed to the App Builder Skill to generate a local WebUI application, or loaded directly through the Python/C++ APIs of QAI AppBuilder.

paragraphs.en: This section reports project deployment, fault diagnosis, repair, and recheck, together with an auxiliary case of an Agent workflow driven by Qwen3.8-27B (§ IV-A , RQ1–RQ2), followed by performance optimization under accuracy constraints (§ IV-B , RQ3).

paragraphs.en: Result and HITL judgment. O means that the target-device path, declared numerical or task Gate, and critical delivery capabilities all pass; required cache, preprocessing, and postprocessing paths must also be usable. ? means that the QAIRT model and scripts run but lack critical capability, sufficient testing, or metric evidence, for example KV-cache, the required accuracy, or the required QNN path after switching to DLC, and requires further work before delivery. X means that the target path, numerical result, or project contract has a substantive error, for example switching to CPU or GPU execution instead of the required target-NPU path, and requires diagnosis and re-execution.

paragraphs.en: This paper purposively selects seven PyTorch projects: vision, Real-ESRGAN [ 41 ] and YOLO-Worldv2 [ 42 ] ; speech, MeloTTS [ 43 ] and Whisper-tiny [ 44 ] ; diffusion, Stable Diffusion v1.5 (SD1.5) [ 45 ] ; and decoder-only LLMs, SmolLM2-135M [ 46 ] and Qwen3-0.6B [ 47 ] . These projects involve convolution, multi-branch detection, encoder-decoder structures, autoregressive caches, large UNets, and different I/O interfaces, and are used to examine the AIPC workflow under different deployment conditions. The YOLO-Worldv2 tests keep the CLIP [ 48 ] component frozen.

paragraphs.en: We observed three patterns in these experiments. (1) Path ambiguity. When tools were invoked through an x86-emulated Python environment, Qwen3.8-27B sometimes identified the target device as x86 and shifted to CPU-simulated or GPU execution. It could also switch to a DLC path after an error on the QNN path.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在这些实验中观察到三种模式。(1) 路径歧义。 当工具通过 x86 模拟的 Python 环境调用时，Qwen3.8-27B 有时会将目标设备识别为 x86，并切换到 CPU 模拟或 GPU 执行。 在 QNN 路径上出错后，它也可能切换到 DLC 路径。

paragraphs.en: With the AIPC Skill ( Skill=Y ). AIPC encodes the project contract, deployment steps, tool invocations, and Gates as executable constraints, allowing the Agent to handle graph surgery, runtime artifacts, and target-device checks in one workflow. For autoregressive models, the Skill can require explicit KV-cache export and match the tensor I/O of the target NPU, so each decode step reuses the existing cache rather than recomputing self-attention over the whole prefix. This reduces per-step computation from O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) over the full prefix to O ⁡ ( n ) O(n) over the cached history.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 AIPC 技能（Skill=Y）时。 AIPC 将项目契约、部署步骤、工具调用和门控（Gates）编码为可执行的约束，使智能体能够在同一工作流中处理图手术、运行时产物以及目标设备检查。 对于自回归模型，该技能可以要求显式导出 KV 缓存，并匹配目标 NPU 的张量输入输出，从而使每个解码步骤复用已有缓存，而不是对整个前缀重新计算自注意力。 这将每步的计算量从对整个前缀的 O(n²) 降低为对缓存历史的 O(n)。

paragraphs.en: Note: the performance series reports medians over 3 runs per arm, each starting from that arm’s pre-fixed baseline artifact. All 14 run artifacts are loadable, and metadata confirms that they execute on the NPU. The two arms of the performance series start from different points (18.16 and 13.85 ms), so speedups are compared rather than absolute end-point latencies. In the accuracy series, “All criteria” means satisfying A1–A5 together; in the performance series, the criteria are judged against each arm’s own starting artifact and require A3–A5, A6, and a consistency check on the confidence threshold, but not A1/A2. The criteria are: A1 mAP@0.5:0.95 ≥ \geq 95% of FP32; A2 mAP@0.5 ≥ \geq 95% of FP32 (MLPerf Inference rule [ 66 ] ); A3 no large drop in recall for any of the 78 classes; A4 no whole class disappears; A5 empty-detection rate ≤ \leq FP32 + 0.02; A6 accuracy drop ≤ \leq 1.0 percentage point. A1 and A2 together form the “overall-accuracy criterion”, and A3–A5 prevent the average from masking degradation in individual classes.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：性能系列报告的是每个分支 3 次运行的中位数，每次运行都从该分支预先固定的基线工件开始。 全部 14 个运行工件均可加载，且元数据确认它们在 NPU 上执行。 性能系列的两个分支起点不同（18.16 和 13.85 毫秒），因此比较的是加速比而非绝对终点延迟。 在精度系列中，“所有标准”指同时满足 A1–A5；在性能系列中，各标准是针对每个分支自身的起始工件来判断的，要求 A3–A5、A6 以及对置信度阈值的一致性检查，但不要求 A1/A2。 这些标准是：A1 mAP@0.5:0.95 ≥ \geq FP32 的 95%；A2 mAP@0.5 ≥ \geq FP32 的 95%（MLPerf Inference 规则 [ 66 ] ）；A3 78 个类别中任何一个的召回率均无大幅下降；A4 没有整类消失；A5 空检测率 ≤ \leq FP32 + 0.02；A6 精度下降 ≤ \leq 1.0 个百分点。 A1 和 A2 共同构成“总体精度标准”，而 A3–A5 防止平均值掩盖个别类别的性能退化。

paragraphs.en: Which knowledge triggered the optimizations (Table VI ). Controlled ablations show that the passing recipe is a conjunction of several changes: without split outputs, accuracy is 0.0% (not a single box is detected in 3,600 images); the other tested missing-item builds reach 74.6%–90.2%, and the best build (96.2%) approaches the 96.4%–97.2% delivered by the Agent.

paragraphs.en: Six of the 7 Skill runs satisfy all criteria, versus 0/6 in the No-Skill arm. All Skill runs meet the WER criterion, and the encoder is 1.07–1.08 × \times the AI Hub package, with the single miss at 1.31 × \times . The No-Skill arm fails mainly on latency: the encoder of its loadable runs is 1.41–13.72 × \times the AI Hub package, 3 of them slower than the naive reference, and 2 further runs delivered no loadable artifact. The difference between the two arms has a Fisher exact test p = 0.0047. In addition, 300 utterances sampled from LibriSpeech test-clean with no overlap with the original evaluation set were used to re-test all 13 artifacts, again giving 6/7 versus 0/6; across 16 combinations of WER and encoder thresholds, the conclusion is unchanged in 12, and only when the encoder bound is relaxed to 1.5 × \times does one No-Skill run pass.

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ3. EQ-B1 : when the methods are recorded in the Skill, the Agent uses them reliably. paragraphs.en: Limitations. The benefit of the Skill depends on the model and backend knowledge recorded in it and does not necessarily apply to all models. The sample is small (1–4 runs per cell, one SoC, one SDK version per model), so the conclusions should not be extrapolated. The contributions of the Skill’s structure and of model-specific recipes cannot be separated: the experiments have only Skill and no-Skill arms, with no workflow-only arm (Config, Pass, Gate, checks, rollback, and records without model-specific recipes). The results therefore show that recording a correct recipe in the Skill makes the Agent adopt it (most clearly for Whisper, where one quantization option explains most of the gap), not that the Config–Pass–Gate workflow itself is the main source of the gain. A workflow-only ablation is left to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 本技能（Skill）的收益取决于模型以及其中记录的后端知识，并不一定适用于所有模型。 样本规模较小（每个单元格 1–4 次运行、单一 SoC、每个模型单一 SDK 版本），因此结论不应外推。 技能结构的贡献与模型专属配方（recipe）的贡献无法分离：实验只有「有技能」和「无技能」两个组，没有「仅工作流」的对照组（即包含配置（Config）、通过（Pass）、门控（Gate）、检查、回滚和记录，但不包含模型专属配方）。 因此，实验结果只能说明在技能中记录正确的配方能使智能体（Agent）采纳该配方（在 Whisper 上最为明显，其中一个量化选项解释了大部分差距），而不能说明「配置–通过–门控」工作流本身是收益的主要来源。 仅针对工作流的消融实验留待未来工作。

paragraphs.en: AIPC advances the workflow with the evidence produced at each stage. Conversion results, evidence of HTP backend execution, output comparisons, project artifacts, and profiling all serve as inputs to later decisions; Gates map this evidence to states that trigger continuation, termination, or a transition to an appropriate Pass; subsequent Passes rebuild affected artifacts when needed. Runtime errors, numerical deviations, and missing artifacts therefore change the subsequent execution path.
paragraphs.zh: AIPC 利用各阶段产生的证据推进工作流。 转换结果、HTP 后端执行的证据、输出对比、项目产物以及性能分析都作为后续决策的输入；Gates 将这些证据映射到触发继续、终止或转换到合适 Pass 的状态；后续 Pass 在需要时重建受影响的产物。 因此，运行时错误、数值偏差和产物缺失会改变后续的执行路径。

paragraphs.en: The Agent’s exploration is confined within an acceptable execution scope by the AIPC Skill, executable checks, budgets, and HITL conditions. Humans provide domain-specific contracts, exception policies, and knowledge during project setup and later maintenance; under a fixed contract and configuration, some runs show that the evidence-driven workflow can support the Agent executing within the set boundaries without human intervention. Current Agents may still drift off the path, so after a run completes, humans can review the results against the run records, generated artifacts, and Gate states. Under this division of labor, the Agent can help reduce the manual burden and knowledge threshold of specialized-hardware deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的探索被 AIPC 技能、可执行的检查、预算以及人机协同（HITL）条件限制在可接受的执行范围内。 人类在项目设置和后续维护过程中提供领域特定的契约、异常策略和知识；在固定的契约和配置下，一些运行结果表明，这种证据驱动的工作流可以支持智能体在设定的边界内无需人工干预地执行。 当前智能体仍可能偏离路径，因此在一次运行完成后，人类可以对照运行记录、生成的产物以及关卡（Gate）状态来审查结果。 在这种分工下，智能体有助于降低专用硬件部署的人工负担和知识门槛。

paragraphs.en: Engineering lessons. The measurements in § IV-B support four lessons directly usable for similar deployments. First, successful conversion does not mean deliverable, and acceptance must be task-level and blocking: the default YOLO recipe ran all 3,600 images with zero errors yet detected no box at all, and the naive Whisper build matched FP32 accuracy but its encoder was 2.32 × \times slower than the AI Hub package. Second, gates must be able to abort the flow rather than only record deviations: across the two cases, 5 of 14 Skill-arm runs still delivered artifacts when the audit gave no pass verdict, and the Agent disclosed this itself in every case. Third, knowledge belongs in audited, tested scripts and not only in documents: a single option coupling activation and weight calibration was never tried in the right direction by the Agent across 22 variants in a run that was later invalidated and used to fix the Skill. Fourth, measure the whole pipeline before tuning the NPU: 89% of YOLO’s 2.791 × \times speedup comes from host-side pre/postprocessing.
paragraphs.zh: 工程经验教训。 § IV-B 中的测量结果支持四条可直接用于类似部署的经验教训。 首先，转换成功并不意味着可交付，验收必须是任务级且具有阻断性的：默认的 YOLO 配方在全部 3,600 张图像上运行且零错误，却没有检测到任何框；朴素的 Whisper 构建在精度上与 FP32 一致，但其编码器比 AI Hub 软件包慢 2.32 × \times 倍。 其次，门控必须能够中止流程，而不仅仅是记录偏差：在两个案例中，14 次 Skill-arm 运行里有 5 次在审计未给出通过结论的情况下仍交付了产物，而智能体在每一次情况下都自行披露了这一点。 第三，知识应存在于经过审计和测试的脚本中，而不仅仅是文档中：一个将激活校准与权重校准耦合在一起的选项，智能体在 22 个变体的运行中从未朝正确的方向尝试过，而该运行后来被判定无效并用于修复 Skill。 第四，在调优 NPU 之前先测量整个流水线：YOLO 的 2.791 × \times 加速中有 89% 来自主机侧的前/后处理。

paragraphs.en: Large composite diffusion pipelines are also constrained by host memory and component size. Taking PixArt- Σ \Sigma DiT (XL/2) [ 67 ] as an example, its T5 [ 68 ] text encoder exceeds 5 GB; in our small-scale exploration, one path completed the DiT part of the deployment but still kept the T5 encoder on the CPU, while the other attempts failed in the repeated conversion stage. Such results vary with the Agent model, configuration, and path selection, indicating that complex models still require a more stable Harness and a more systematic evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 大型复合扩散流水线同样受到主机内存和组件规模的限制。 以 PixArt- \Sigma DiT (XL/2) [ 67 ] 为例，其 T5 [ 68 ] 文本编码器超过 5 GB；在我们的小规模探索中，一条路径完成了 DiT 部分的部署，但 T5 编码器仍保留在 CPU 上，而其他尝试则在反复转换阶段失败。 此类结果随智能体模型、配置和路径选择而变化，表明复杂模型仍需要更稳定的测试框架（Harness）和更系统化的评估。

paragraphs.en: The current AIPC focuses on adaptation, quantization, and graph-level optimization of existing PyTorch projects. Future work will extend to new model backbones such as Mamba and MoE, and to optimization capabilities such as kernel/operator generation, QAT, and pruning; it will also improve the stability of the Harness and evaluate its applicability and engineering overhead on more models.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的AIPC专注于对现有PyTorch项目进行适配、量化和图级优化。 未来的工作将扩展到新的模型骨干，如Mamba和MoE，以及内核/算子生成、QAT和剪枝等优化能力；同时还将提升Harness的稳定性，并在更多模型上评估其适用性和工程开销。

sents.en: Future work will extend to new model backbones such as Mamba and MoE, and to optimization capabilities such as kernel/operator generation, QAT, and pruning; it will also improve the stability of the Harness and evaluate its applicability and engineering overhead on more models.
sents.zh: 未来的工作将扩展到新的模型骨干，如Mamba和MoE，以及内核/算子生成、QAT和剪枝等优化能力；同时还将提升Harness的稳定性，并在更多模型上评估其适用性和工程开销。

paragraphs.en: AIPC encodes the target-NPU deployment of a complete PyTorch inference project as a workflow composed of Config, Pass, and Gate. Model Builder establishes a deployment baseline on the target device; the Optimizer generates optimized variants from runtime feedback under accuracy, project-interface, and target-backend constraints. The Agent selects Passes and tools according to workflow state.
paragraphs.zh: AIPC 将一个完整的 PyTorch 推理项目向目标 NPU 的部署编码为由 Config、Pass 和 Gate 组成的工作流。 Model Builder 在目标设备上建立部署基线；Optimizer 在精度、项目接口和目标后端约束下，根据运行时反馈生成优化变体。 智能体根据工作流状态选择 Pass 和工具。

paragraphs.en: On Qualcomm QAIRT on-device NPUs, this paper reports target-backend execution, output comparison, fault diagnosis, and profiling results for vision, speech, LLM, and diffusion tasks. Some fixed-contract runs achieve 0-HITL. In two optimization cases, AIPC’s optimization knowledge and strategies guide the Agent to accuracy and performance gains (Whisper-Small all criteria 6/7 vs. 0/6; YOLO-Worldv2 speedup 2.791 × \times , mainly from the host side). The Agent auxiliary experiment with Qwen3.8-27B shows that this model can drive the deployment workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 在高通 QAIRT 端侧 NPU 上，本文报告了视觉、语音、大语言模型和扩散模型任务在目标后端上的执行、输出对比、故障诊断和性能分析结果。 一些固定契约的运行实现了 0-HITL（零人工介入）。 在两个优化案例中，AIPC 的优化知识与策略引导智能体在精度和性能上获得提升（Whisper-Small 全部标准 6/7 对 0/6；YOLO-Worldv2 加速 2.791 × \times ，主要来自主机侧）。 使用 Qwen3.8-27B 的智能体辅助实验表明，该模型能够驱动整个部署工作流。

paragraphs.en: These results support the following engineering conclusion: runtime feedback can drive cross-layer diagnosis, candidate repair, and re-checking of the model graph, project interface, or runtime configuration. AIPC thus provides an implementable engineering path for “AI Deployment by AI”.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果支持以下工程结论：运行时反馈可以驱动跨层诊断、候选修复，以及对模型图、项目接口或运行时配置的重新检查。 因此，AIPC 为「用 AI 做部署」（AI Deployment by AI）提供了一条可实施的工程路径。
